name: Summer Horsemanship Program
operator_name: Dana Hall School (Karen Stives '68 Equestrian Center)
description_short: A half-day horseback riding camp at Dana Hall's equestrian center, focused on hunt-seat equitation, safety and horse care. Riders of all levels are welcome, including first-timers. Camp runs Monday to Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 1 p.m.
refund_policy_summary: A $200 nonrefundable deposit is due February 1. The remaining balance is due April 15 and is also nonrefundable.
